svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

svg.text: Corner pieces (4): 150 mm of 30 x 30 x 3 aluminium angle;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: one leg covers the end of the side board and the end board's

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: face, the other the side board's face.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two 6.5 mm holes in each leg at 50 and 100 mm up, drilled

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: through the boards' corner holes with the piece clamped on.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Board brackets (10): 40 mm of the same angle; one 6.5 mm hole

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: in each leg, 15 mm from the corner, centred.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: bracket flat leg on the deck, bolted down through the deck

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: into a frame rivet nut; upright leg on the board's inside

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: face with an M6 bolt and wing nut. Corner pieces: M6 bolts

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: with wing nuts through both boards.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: To take a board off: undo its wing nuts and lift it.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Flag pole: 12 mm pole in two clips on the left board's inside

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: face, 30 mm behind the front board, at 40 and 120 mm up.
